mapper.sql: select s.shop_code, s.serialcode as serial_no, s.goodscode as goods_code, s.goodsname as goods_name, s.spec, s.unit, s.batchcode as batch_code, s.costprice as cost_price, s.warecode as ware_code, s.warename as ware_name, s.qualityflag as quality_flag, s.onhandflag as onhand_flag, s.indoccode as inbound_doc, s.indetailcode as inbound_detail, s.outdoccode as outbound_doc, s.outdetailcode as outbound_detail, case when s.activeflag = 1 then 'instock' else 'outstock' end as serial_status, s.intime as in_time, s.outtime as out_time, b.purchasecode as purchase_code, b.partnercode as partner_code, s.createtime as create_time from sdsshop.u_m_serial s left join sdsshop.u_m_batchinfo b on b.shop_code = s.shop_code and b.batchcode = s.batchcode and b.goodscode = s.goodscode and b.warecode = s.warecode and b.qualityflag = s.qualityflag and b.onhandflag = s.onhandflag
mapper.insert: insert into sdsshop.u_m_serial( shop_code, serialcode, goodscode, goodsname, spec, unit, batchcode, costprice, warecode, warename, qualityflag, onhandflag, activeflag, indoccode, indetailcode, intime, outdoccode, outdetailcode, outtime, remark, createtime ) values( #{shopCode}, #{serialNo}, #{goodsCode}, #{goodsName}, #{spec, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{unit, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, coalesce(#{batchCode, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, ''), #{costPrice, jdbcType=DECIMAL}, #{wareCode}, #{wareName}, coalesce(#{qualityFlag, jdbcType=INTEGER}, 1), coalesce(#{onhandFlag, jdbcType=INTEGER}, 1), case when #{status} = 'outstock' then 0 else 1 end, coalesce(#{inboundDoc, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, 'MANUAL'), coalesce(#{inboundDetail, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{serialNo}), coalesce(#{inTime, jdbcType=TIMESTAMP}, sysdate()), #{outboundDoc, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{outboundDetail, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{outTime, jdbcType=TIMESTAMP}, '', sysdate() )
mapper.update: update sdsshop.u_m_serial set goodsname = #{goodsName}, warecode = #{wareCode}, warename = #{wareName}, qualityflag = coalesce(#{qualityFlag, jdbcType=INTEGER}, qualityflag), onhandflag = coalesce(#{onhandFlag, jdbcType=INTEGER}, onhandflag), costprice = coalesce(#{costPrice, jdbcType=DECIMAL}, costprice), indoccode = coalesce(#{inboundDoc, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, indoccode), outdoccode = #{outboundDoc, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, activeflag = case when #{status} = 'outstock' then 0 else 1 end, intime = coalesce(#{inTime, jdbcType=TIMESTAMP}, intime), outtime = #{outTime, jdbcType=TIMESTAMP} where shop_code = #{shopCode} and serialcode = #{serialNo}
